response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND l.`U-PRO` <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX;
